### HB1393 (2026)

- **Policy ID:** `ms-hb1393-2026`
- **Sponsor / party:** Reps. Brent Powell and Jeff Hale; Republican
- **Status:** Approved by Governor 2026-04-08; enacted as Chapter 459, Laws of 2026, effective 2026-07-01
- **Provisions:** Creates the Mississippi Energy Infrastructure Fund. The definition of "project" includes data centers, making data-center-serving energy infrastructure potentially eligible for grants, loans, or other assistance through MDA, while excluding electric utilities as direct recipients.
- **Mechanism / scope:** other; fiscal
- **Legal effect:** unknown
- **Effective date:** 2026-07-01
- **End condition and limitations:** Original act provides for repeal of Section 1 on July 1, 2029; later amendments not checked.
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/2026/pdf/history/HB/HB1393.xml>)
